web.title: IJCAI
web.description:
# Welcome to IJCAI
[IJCAI-25](https://2025.ijcai.org/) was held from August 16th until August 22, 2025 in Montreal, Canada and from August 29th until Augst 31st, 2025 in Guangzhou, China.

web.title: Bremen Officially Confirmed as Host City for IJCAI-ECAI 2026
web.description: At the close of this year’s International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI), held from August 11–17, 2025 in Montreal, Canada, and August 29–31, 2025 in Guangzhou, China, the official announcement was made: The next edition of the prestigious conference – IJCAI-ECAI 2026 – will take place in Bremen from August 15 to 21, 2026.
